+---
+assignees:

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: bd80
+title: Decide if AgentAuthView shows AuthFailure.Reason.message for each failure reason
+---
+## What
+FoundationModelsACPClient e1cac1d adds `AuthFailure.Reason.message`: a text that a UI can show for each reason (request, terminal, unsupported). `AgentAuthView.text(of:)` uses this text only for `unsupported`. For `terminal`, the kit still has its own texts in `terminalText(exitStatus:message:)` ("The sign-in process ended with no exit status." and "... ended with exit status N."). The client gives other texts for the same reason ("The sign-in process did not stop normally." and "The sign-in process stopped with exit status N.").
+
+Thus the kit has a second text table for a value that the client model already describes. This is against the rule that the kit views bind directly to the client model and keep no logic of their own. But the kit texts use `String(localized:)`, and the client texts are not localized.
+
+Found in ^vewxkf3. That task kept the kit terminal texts, because a change of the shown text was not in its scope.
+
+## Decision to make
+- Option 1: `AgentAuthView` shows `failure.reason.message` for each reason. Remove `text(of:)` and `terminalText(exitStatus:message:)`. Change the expected texts of `aRunnerWithNoExitStatusShowsTheTerminalFailureText` and `aNonZeroExitStatusShowsTheTerminalFailureTextWithTheStatus` in `Tests/AgentViewKitTests/Connections/AgentAuthViewHostedTests.swift`.
+- Option 2: keep the localized kit texts for `terminal`, and record the reason in the doc comment of `AgentAuthView`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The owner picks one option, and the card records it.
+- [ ] The code and the hosted tests follow that option. `swift test` passes.
\ No newline at end of file
